# Endoscopy procedure rooms

!!! info "Definition"
    An endoscopy procedure room is a specialised clinical room where minimally invasive procedures are performed using an endoscope to examine, diagnose and sometimes treat conditions inside the body.

## Activity classification

Activity is limited to daycase spells with a primary procedure code in one of the
following groups:

* Oesophagoscopy: G14, G15, G16, G17, G18, G19, G20
* Oesophagogastroduodenoscopy (OGD): G42, G43, G44, G45, G46
* Duodenoscopy: G54, G55
* Jejunoscopy: G64, G65
* Ileoscopy: G79, G80
* Sigmoidoscopy: H23, H24, H25, H26, H27, H28, H37, H69, H70, H71
* Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP): J38, J39, J40, J41, J42, J43, J44, J45
* Colonoscopy: H20, H21, H22, H68
* Bronchoscopy: E48, E49, E50, E51

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

The primary procedure from each qualifying daycase spell is used to estimate procedure
hours using the assumed procedure time.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Procedure hours}
    =
    \text{Procedures}
    \times
    \frac{\text{Procedure time (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of endoscopy procedure rooms by dividing procedure hours
by the product of the service's annual operational hours and the assumed utilisation rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Required endoscopy rooms}
    =
    \frac{\text{Procedure hours}}
    {\text{Annual operational hours} \times \text{Utilisation rate}}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All groups | Procedure time | Pathway |
| All groups | Utilisation rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |
